channel.title: Capture Verification Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Capture Verification

item.title: Version 3.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Multi-Drive Backup Workflow: Can't connect all your backup drives at once? Now you can verify them in batches. Set how many total drives you expect, verify the ones connected now, swap drives, and re-verify — all results are remembered and included in the final report.
  • Verify Remaining Drives: A prompt appears on the results window showing how many drives still need verification, with a dedicated sheet to add and verify additional drives without re-running the full session scan.
  • Stale Cache Detection: If the master session changes between verification batches, previously verified drives are flagged as stale so you know which ones need to be re-verified.
  • Open Report Button: Quickly open your generated PDF report directly from the results window.
